user.title: 3D Floorplan (Container)
user.description: The address of the floorplan3d container, as Home Assistant reaches it — usually its IP address and port, for example http://192.168.1.10:8100. The plan is then served at /floorplan/ on Home Assistant's own address.

reconfigure.title: 3D Floorplan (Container)
reconfigure.description: The address of the floorplan3d container, as Home Assistant reaches it.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answers at this address. Is the container running, and is the address the one Home Assistant can reach?
error.cannot_start_login: The container does not offer the Home Assistant login. The container version needs HA_URL and HA_TOKEN (not SUPERVISOR_TOKEN).
error.login_incomplete: The container answered, but not the way this integration expects. Is it this program (floorplan3d)?
error.invalid_address: That is not an http:// or https:// address.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one floor plan can be served at /floorplan/.
abort.entry_not_found: The integration entry no longer exists.

update_container.title: 3D Floorplan: update the container
update_container.description:
The integration 3D Floorplan (Container) has version {connector}, the 3D Floorplan container has {container}. Both come from the same release and belong together; with different versions the sign-in can fail or the page can show error 502.

Update the container: in the folder with its `docker-compose.yml` run `docker compose pull` and then `docker compose up -d`. This notice goes away by itself within an hour once both have the same version.

update_connector.title: 3D Floorplan: update the integration
update_connector.description:
The 3D Floorplan container has version {container}, the integration 3D Floorplan (Container) still has {connector}. Both come from the same release and belong together; with different versions the sign-in can fail or the page can show error 502.

Update the integration in HACS (with a beta container, switch on the beta versions there), or copy the folder from `floorplan3d-connector.zip` of the release {container}. Then restart Home Assistant: this notice goes away once both have the same version.
